hints.title: Redundant Height Check Avoidance
hints.text: Checking whether left and right subtree heights differ by more than one for every node top-down results in repeated height calculations. How can you combine height calculation and balance validation in a single bottom-up pass?

hints.title: Sentinel Error Propagation
hints.text: Return the height if a subtree is balanced, or a sentinel value like -1 as soon as an imbalance is detected anywhere in the subtree.

hints.title: Bottom-Up Height and Balance Procedure
hints.text: Define a helper function returning the height of a node. If the node is null, return 0. Recursively get left and right heights. If either returns -1, or if the absolute difference between them exceeds 1, return -1. Otherwise, return 1 + max(left, right). Check if the root returns non-negative.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree (0 <= N <= 5000)
H: tree height (log N balanced, N skewed)
complexity.notes: Visits each node at most once with early termination when imbalance is detected.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing height at every node independently takes O(N^2) time on unbalanced trees because child nodes are re-traversed repeatedly by their ancestors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Returning -1 upon detecting imbalance short-circuits evaluation in O(N) linear time and O(H) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Avoiding O(N^2) top-down height checks, implementing early exit with sentinel -1, and clear base cases.

solutions.approach: Single-Pass Height with Sentinel Early Exit
